scanNote:
VIDEO PROJECT - UNIT 2: ANASTASIA (93') (87-bet, PDF 74). Yuqorida 'UNIT 2 Anastasia (93')', o'ngda kinoproyektor rasmi, o'ng chekkada to'q sariq yo'lak. SURAT: multfilmdan kadr - Anastasiya (qisqa soch, oddiy kiyimda) devordagi kichik qiz surati (rasm) oldida turibdi.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the picture.' 1 Where is Anastasia? 2 Who is the little girl in the painting?
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Anastasia was the youngest daughter of the Tsar of ...... . A France B Russia C Germany. 2 At the beginning of the film Anastasia was ...... . A at a concert B at a play C at a ball. 3 Empress Maria, Anastasia's grandmother, gave her ...... . A a music box B a jewellery box C a wooden box. 4 The evil man who wanted to destroy the Romanov family was ...... . A Dimitri B Vladimir C Rasputin. 5 Anastasia's family, the Romanovs, were killed during the ...... . A review B revision C revolution. 6 ...... helped Anastasia to escape. A Rasputin B Dimitri C Anya. 7 When she was 18, Anastasia left the ...... . A hospital B prison C orphanage. 8 ...... became Anastasia's best friend. A Pooka B Pelka C Beeka.
3) 'Anastasia's life at the orphanage was very different to her life at the palace. Use the prompts to talk about her life, as in the examples.' Jadval THEN: wear/beautiful clothes; eat/delicious food; own/expensive jewellery; have/loving family; live/huge, luxurious palace; meet/famous people. NOW: wear/ragged clothes; eat/plain soup; own/nothing; have/no one; live/small, cramped orphanage; meet/only other orphans. e.g. Then she used to wear beautiful clothes. Now she wears ragged clothes. (5 ta bo'sh qator.)

O'NG USTUN:
4) 'Explain why the name "Anastasia" is a suitable one.'
5) 'Tick the different forms of transport Anya, Dimitri and Vladimir use.' plane, ship, horse, bus, train, lorry (katakchalar).
6) 'Find the answer.' 1 Where were they travelling to? ...... [RSPIA] 2 Dimitri tries to talk to Empress Maria when they are at the ...... . [LABLTE] 3 What does it say on Anastasia's necklace? ...... in Paris. [ROTEEGHT]
7) 'Write a sentence about what happens at the end of the story to:' a) Rasputin b) Dimitri and Anastasia c) Bartok (the bat)
'TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION': 1 Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents? Tell the class.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '87'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. 1 Where is Anastasia? 2 Who is the little girl in the painting?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. 1 Anastasiya qayerda? 2 Rasmdagi kichkina qiz kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
SURAT: Anastasiya (Anya) qisqa
  soch, oddiy kiyimda - devordagi
  kichik qiz rasmiga qarab turibdi.

  1 U eski saroyda (Sankt-
    Peterburgdagi Romanovlar
    saroyida) - rasm galereyasida.
  2 Rasmdagi kichkina qiz - o'zi,
    Anastasiya bolaligida (malika
    kiyimida). U buni hali
    eslamaydi.


⚠ 'A PAINTING':

  = rasm (bo'yoq bilan chizilgan).


⚠ FILM HAQIDA:

  'Anastasia' (1997) - rus
  malikasi Anastasiya Romanova
  haqidagi multfilm. Inqilobda
  oilasi halok bo'ladi, u xotirasini
  yo'qotib bolalar uyida 'Anya'
  bo'lib o'sadi.

items.question: Where is Anastasia?
items.answer: She is in the old palace, looking at a painting on the wall.

items.question: Who is the little girl in the painting?
items.answer: The little girl in the painting is Anastasia herself when she was a child.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM SYUJETI - 8 ta fakt.

  1 Tsar of RUSSIA - Rossiya
    podshosi Nikolay II
  2 AT A BALL - saroyda bazm
  3 A MUSIC BOX - musiqa qutisi
    (buvisi bergan)
  4 RASPUTIN - yovuz sehrgar
  5 the REVOLUTION - 1917 inqilob
  6 DIMITRI - saroy xizmatchisi
    bola, qochishga yordam bergan
  7 the ORPHANAGE - bolalar uyi
  8 POOKA - kuchuk, eng yaqin
    do'sti


⚠ 'TSAR':

  = podsho (rus).


⚠ 'EMPRESS':

  = imperator ayol / malika-ona.


⚠ 'REVIEW / REVISION / REVOLUTION':

  review = sharh; revision =
  takrorlash; revolution = inqilob.

items.textEn: Anastasia was the youngest daughter of the Tsar of ___.
items.uz: Anastasiya Rossiya podshosining kenja qizi edi.

items.textEn: At the beginning of the film Anastasia was ___.
Empress Maria, Anastasia's grandmother, gave her ___.
items.uz: Buvisi imperatritsa Mariya unga musiqa qutisi berdi.

items.textEn: The evil man who wanted to destroy the Romanov family was ___.
items.uz: Romanovlar oilasini yo'q qilmoqchi bo'lgan yovuz odam Rasputin edi.

items.textEn: Anastasia's family, the Romanovs, were killed during the ___.
items.uz: Anastasiyaning oilasi - Romanovlar inqilob paytida o'ldirildi.

items.textEn: When she was 18, Anastasia left the ___.
items.uz: 18 yoshida Anastasiya bolalar uyini tark etdi.
Puka Anastasiyaning eng yaqin do'sti bo'ldi.

exercises.instructionEn: Anastasia's life at the orphanage was very different to her life at the palace. Use the prompts to talk about her life, as in the examples. THEN: wear/beautiful clothes; eat/delicious food; own/expensive jewellery; have/loving family; live/huge, luxurious palace; meet/famous people. NOW: wear/ragged clothes; eat/plain soup; own/nothing; have/no one; live/small, cramped orphanage; meet/only other orphans.
exercises.instructionUz: Anastasiyaning bolalar uyidagi hayoti saroydagi hayotidan juda farq qilardi. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib uning hayoti haqida namunadagidek gapiring. ILGARI: chiroyli kiyim; mazali taom; qimmat taqinchoq; mehribon oila; ulkan hashamatli saroy; mashhur odamlar. HOZIR: yirtiq kiyim; oddiy sho'rva; hech narsa; hech kim; kichik, tor bolalar uyi; faqat boshqa yetimlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO (ilgari) va PRESENT SIMPLE
  (hozir) - 2-unit grammatikasi.

  Then she USED TO + fe'l.
  Now she + fe'l(s).

  ⚠ 'own nothing' = hech narsaga
  ega emas; 'have no one' = hech
  kimi yo'q.


⚠ 'RAGGED':

  = yirtiq, juldur.


⚠ 'CRAMPED':

  = tor, siqiq.


⚠ 'LUXURIOUS':

  = hashamatli.
exercises.exampleEn: Then she used to wear beautiful clothes. Now she wears ragged clothes.
exercises.exampleUz: Ilgari u chiroyli kiyimlar kiyardi. Hozir u yirtiq kiyim kiyadi.
modelAnswers: Then she used to wear beautiful clothes. Now she wears ragged clothes.
Then she used to eat delicious food. Now she eats plain soup.
Then she used to own expensive jewellery. Now she owns nothing.
Then she used to have a loving family. Now she has no one.
Then she used to live in a huge, luxurious palace. Now she lives in a small, cramped orphanage.
Then she used to meet famous people. Now she meets only other orphans.
modelAnswersUz: Ilgari u chiroyli kiyimlar kiyardi. Hozir u yirtiq kiyim kiyadi. (NAMUNA)
Ilgari u mazali taomlar yerdi. Hozir u oddiy sho'rva yeydi.
Ilgari uning qimmat taqinchoqlari bor edi. Hozir uning hech narsasi yo'q.
Ilgari uning mehribon oilasi bor edi. Hozir uning hech kimi yo'q.
Ilgari u ulkan, hashamatli saroyda yashardi. Hozir u kichik, tor bolalar uyida yashaydi.
Ilgari u mashhur odamlar bilan uchrashardi. Hozir u faqat boshqa yetimlar bilan uchrashadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Explain why the name 'Anastasia' is a suitable one.
exercises.instructionUz: Nima uchun 'Anastasiya' ismi mos ekanini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'ANASTASIA' ISMINING MA'NOSI.

  Yunoncha 'anastasis' = QAYTA
  TIRILISh, tiklanish. Filmda
  Anastasiya 'o'lgan' deb hisoblanadi,
  lekin u tirik chiqadi va o'z
  o'tmishini, oilasini (buvisini)
  qayta topadi - ya'ni 'qayta
  tiriladi'.


⚠ 'SUITABLE':

  = mos, munosib.

items.en: Why is the name 'Anastasia' a suitable one?
items.answerEn: The name 'Anastasia' means 'resurrection' or 'she who will rise again'. Everyone thought Anastasia was dead, but she 'came back to life' and found her grandmother and her past again.
items.answerUz: 'Anastasiya' ismi 'qayta tirilish' yoki 'qayta tiriladigan' degan ma'noni bildiradi. Hamma Anastasiyani o'lgan deb o'ylardi, lekin u 'qayta tirildi' va buvisini hamda o'tmishini qayta topdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the different forms of transport Anya, Dimitri and Vladimir use: plane, ship, horse, bus, train, lorry.
exercises.instructionUz: Anya, Dimitri va Vladimir foydalangan transport turlarini belgilang: samolyot, kema, ot, avtobus, poyezd, yuk mashinasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILMDAGI SAYOHAT: Sankt-
  Peterburg → Parij.

  ✓ TRAIN - poyezdda Rossiyadan
    chiqishadi (Rasputin poyezdni
    buzadi)
  ✓ SHIP - kemada Germaniyadan
    Fransiyaga (Rasputin bo'ron
    yuboradi)
  ✓ BUS - Parijda avtobus
  ✗ plane, horse, lorry - yo'q


⚠ 'A LORRY':

  = yuk mashinasi (BrE; AmE -
  truck).

exercises.instructionEn: Find the answer (unscramble the letters in brackets).
exercises.explanationUz:
ARALASh HARFLAR.

  1 RSPIA → PARIS - ular Parijga
    ketishyapti (buvisi o'sha
    yerda)
  2 LABLTE → BALLET - balet
    teatrida Dimitri imperatritsa
    bilan gaplashmoqchi bo'ladi
  3 ROTEEGHT → TOGETHER - marjonda
    'Together in Paris' (Parijda
    birga) yozilgan


⚠ 'A NECKLACE':

  = marjon, bo'yinga taqiladigan
  zeb-ziynat.

items.textEn: Dimitri tries to talk to Empress Maria when they are at the ___. [LABLTE]
What does it say on Anastasia's necklace? ___ in Paris. [ROTEEGHT]

exercises.instructionEn: Write a sentence about what happens at the end of the story to: a) Rasputin b) Dimitri and Anastasia c) Bartok (the bat).
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya oxirida quyidagilarga nima bo'lishi haqida bittadan gap yozing: a) Rasputin b) Dimitri va Anastasiya c) Bartok (ko'rshapalak).
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM OXIRI.

  a) Rasputin - Anastasiya uning
     sehrli idishini sindiradi va
     u yo'q bo'lib ketadi (o'ladi).
  b) Dimitri va Anastasiya - bir-
     birini sevib qolishadi va
     birga ketishadi (Anastasiya
     malika hayotidan voz kechadi).
  c) Bartok - Rasputinning
     ko'rshapalagi ozod bo'ladi va
     boshqa ko'rshapalak bilan
     sevishib qoladi.


⚠ 'A BAT':

  = ko'rshapalak.
exercises.exampleEn: a) At the end of the story Rasputin ...
modelAnswers: a) At the end of the story Anastasia breaks Rasputin's magic reliquary and he is destroyed.
b) Dimitri and Anastasia fall in love and go away together to start a new life.
c) Bartok, the bat, is free at last and finds a girlfriend bat.
modelAnswersUz: a) Hikoya oxirida Anastasiya Rasputinning sehrli idishini sindiradi va u yo'q bo'lib ketadi.
b) Dimitri va Anastasiya bir-birini sevib qolishadi va yangi hayot boshlash uchun birga ketishadi.
c) Ko'rshapalak Bartok nihoyat ozod bo'ladi va o'ziga ko'rshapalak qiz do'st topadi.

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents? Tell the class.
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Buvi-buvangiz bilan munosabatingiz yaxshimi? Sinfga aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA - Anastasiya va buvisi
  (Empress Maria) munosabati.

  Namuna javob:
  'Yes, I have a very good
  relationship with my
  grandparents. I visit them every
  weekend. My grandmother tells me
  stories about the past and my
  grandfather teaches me to play
  chess.'


⚠ 'A RELATIONSHIP':

  = munosabat.

points.en: Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents?
points.noteUz: Namuna: 'Yes, I do. I visit my grandparents every weekend and my grandmother tells me stories about the past.' (Ha. Har dam olish kuni buvi-buvamnikiga boraman va buvim menga o'tmish haqida hikoyalar aytib beradi.)

patterns.formula: Then she used to + FE'L. Now she + FE'L(s).
patterns.exampleEn: Then she used to live in a huge palace. Now she lives in a small orphanage.
patterns.exampleUz: Ilgari u ulkan saroyda yashardi. Hozir u kichik bolalar uyida yashaydi.

patterns.formula: At the end of the story + KIM + FE'L (present simple)
patterns.exampleEn: At the end of the story Dimitri and Anastasia fall in love.
patterns.exampleUz: Hikoya oxirida Dimitri va Anastasiya sevishib qolishadi.
